Thinking

Beyond Bhavya

Why companies win, why policies shift, and what a balance sheet doesn’t say.

Beyond Bhavya is my series of short business and finance explainers. A balance sheet tells you what a company earned and owes. It rarely tells you why it won, why it stumbled, or what the market believed along the way. That is the space I write about.

Each post takes one story and breaks it down in plain language, on a single page. I have looked at what separated Apple’s two eras, why Berkshire Hathaway placed a big bet on Japan, how the yen carry trade works, and why Korean stocks trade at a “discount”. I have also written about how a policy can decide which company wins, from Shakti Pumps and wind energy to Chinese versus Indian steel, and about the business behind everyday names like Swiggy, Petpooja, quick commerce and India Stack.

I write as a Chartered Accountant who likes to read the numbers and then ask what they leave out. New posts go up on LinkedIn first, and every one is collected here.
